quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin on the lingering tension from his time with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I wish we had a conversation a lot earlier because it's hilarious, I've never told you this.
quotes.quote: I wish we had a conversation a lot earlier because it's hilarious, I've never told you this. Obviously, I leave the Knicks and we never talked it out. There's this elephant in the room. Every time we play against each other, I'm like, I'll say what's up to you if you say what's up to me, and you're probably like, I'll say what's up to you, and so we never say what's up to each other.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Carmelo Anthony's intense focus during games
quotes.excerpt: I could tell Shorty done checked out. He doesn't even like process the ball no more.
quotes.quote: By the time Melo, you'll see in the game where Melo literally he shot a shot and the shot went in, but he doesn't even like process the ball no more. Like he just turns his whole attention to this man. He's running back. He's not looking at the game. Like the game was over with for Melo. Like it didn't matter unless it was going to be one-on-one. If you going to throw me this ball and you going to guard me, then it meant something. Other than that, it was like how many shots can I miss and we bump each other and do. It was wild. Like I could tell Shorty done checked out.

quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas

quotes.quote: I don't like when big men hit guards. You already know we can't fight. We all living we all living. What you bias? You can't fight? I can fight my size. I'm not fighting big men. Your job is to protect. We the little ones. We just run our mouths. That's what we do. Y'all do the physical. So you coming all the way to Summer League to put your hands on me? I don't respect you no more.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on his long-standing tension with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I don't like his ass. Not a little bit. I understand what he means to Melo.
quotes.quote: I don't like his ass. Not a little bit. I understand what he means to Melo. I understand what he means to Dwyane Wade, my boys. I understand it. But all I'm going to say, when it comes to that, Melo is 1,000% right. This dates back more than a decade. I'm not going to go in the detail of the shit this man has tried to do to me. People don't understand. You don't know you you do not understand the lengths this man would go to. You know, I believe he's one way publicly, he's another way privately. I believe he's, you know, he might not be interviewed and he might not be quoted, but the things he says and the things he has said to people, it's gotten back to me.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on the pressure of taking the COVID vaccine
quotes.excerpt: I took that damn vaccine. Who the hell are they not to take the vaccine?
quotes.quote: I'm living in a world where you got cats making 38, 40, 45 million. You got GMs and owners complaining about it, and you got billionaires looking me in the face and saying, 'Yo, Stephen A., I took that damn vaccine. Who the hell are they not to take the vaccine?' And we're living in a country where the government was imposing all of that on us. So I'm sitting there going like this: We all taking the risk.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on his relationship with Kyrie Irving
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie and I were cool, and he had confided in me about some thoughts.
quotes.quote: Kyrie and I were cool, and he had confided in me about some thoughts. Remember he came on First Take to talk about LeBron when he departed from Cleveland. And then all of a sudden, when he was speaking about the collective bargaining thing, I said, 'That's not wise.' Why? Because I'm the elder statesman. I'm telling you what's going on. I'm going to tip you, I'm going to hip you to the game.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith on his relationship with Carmelo Anthony
quotes.excerpt: I got a better relationship with Melo, obviously, than I do with LeBron.
quotes.quote: I got a better relationship with Melo, obviously, than I do with LeBron. So, if your son was in the same situation as Bronny, I'd have been like, 'Come in, let me talk to you.' And he talked to you. Because I want you to know that from the media's perspective, here's how it's looking. This is what's coming down the pike. Guard against that so we don't have to talk about it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on Larry Brown suspending LeBron, AI, and Amar'e
quotes.excerpt: The minute I knew what type of environment that was going to be was when they got suspended.
quotes.quote: The minute I knew what type of environment that was going to be was when they got suspended in Florida. For being a minute early. So what? Wait, what happened? Let's walk with me. Say there's a meeting at 2:00 p.m. You get there at 1:57, right? The meeting starts at 1:55. Right? Now you get suspended. We about to go play Puerto Rico and Jacksonville. We coming to meet and he like, 'You ain't playing, you ain't playing, you ain't playing.' But mind you, we just got together for like a week and a half. But mind you, we starting to... we like, 'Shit, we get to play against Puerto Rico.' And we home in the U.S. and he's home in Florida. I'm in Florida. So, family in town, you know what I'm saying? And you ain't know about the suspension until before the tip.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the suspension of LeBron, AI, and Amar'e
quotes.excerpt: It was you, AI, and Brown. Really? You talk about the three biggest names at this point in time.
quotes.quote: It was you, AI, and Brown. Really? You talk about the three biggest names at this point in time. You talk about AI who was damn near the face of the world in basketball, champ. You got this young Rookie of the Year, you know what I'm saying, Stoudemire, and then you got Brown who's the next... who's about to be Rookie of the Year. Yeah, that's crazy. Well, he wasn't about to be Rookie of the Year. He already was. He already was. Yeah. He wasn't about to be Rookie of the Year. Understood. But I'm just saying like now you have this ready to go and then you made a statement. And I respect the statement that you made and you stood on it, right? And as you as you get older you start, 'Okay, I understand if you on time then you late.' I get all of that. I get that. Yeah. But don't start the meeting early.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on the origin of the 'Superman' nickname
quotes.excerpt: The Superman for me came from all the things I was doing in the community.
quotes.quote: I have no idea where it came from. I've seen stuff since I've been in Orlando about me trying to take Superman or things like that, but the Superman for me came from all the things I was doing in the community. It came from me jumping over teammates, me doing stuff in the weight room, all these different things is why they were calling me Superman. It wasn't because I went around boasting about being Superman and carry the S on my chest. There's nothing in my house besides a Lego piece that I was given or gifts that I was given that says I'm Superman. I don't put it on my body, I don't run around and say I'm Superman. That's just a name that was given to me.

quotes.speaker: Dwight Howard
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwight Howard on the insecurity of criticizing other players
quotes.excerpt: It's insecurity when you got to speak on another man or female in any negative light.
quotes.quote: It's insecurity. You can call it what it is, that's insecure when you got to speak on another man or female in any negative light. There's nothing that I could say bad about someone if I don't know them. I can only speak positive. If it's something that's negative or something, I just feel like in my opinion, I feel like that's some some insecurity.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the 'passing of the torch' in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: There's always like a path, not a passing of the torch, but it's like almost like a...
quotes.quote: And speaking as not just me, but like for the majority of people who just love the game, the way I grew up, the OGs like after they're on their way out, there's always like a path, not a passing of the torch, but it's like almost like a, 'Yo, I'm going to make sure this room is better than I left it.' To that point, I love that. To that point, right? At the time that you came into the league, Shaq was already older in the league. Right? The fact that they were saying Dwight's the next Shaq. Same smile, he's the new Shaq. Not same smile, but same... he's the new Shaq. They were both big, fun-loving centers like the way Shaq was in Orlando. Same way he was.
